rule: a change is a difference in the Current Status or Reason cell of the same (club, player) key between two consecutive revisions; a row that appears or disappears is reported separately and never treated as a status change; rows whose spelling differs between the revisions are paired by club+surname and reported under spelling_moves

rows_added.change: row not present in the older revision

spelling_moves.note: the two official revisions spell the same club+player differently; not counted as an added row, and the status change (if any) is reported here so nothing is hidden by the key mismatch

note: the final quarter-hour before tip: the 01:15 PM revision against the 01:00 PM one
